title: Great App
body: Really loving the app. Hope it gets a dark mode update soon
author: alaodaniel

title: Helps me improve. I love this app
body: Habit helps me track my past, present and future on the go, and that is helping me improve on myself. Having something to tick at the start or at the end of the day is soo rewarding 😅. It’s like having a tap n the back for a job well done. I’m really grateful for this app 😘
author: Zardlife

title: Super helpful 😁
body: Finally a habit app that’s free. It has a very cute design and is easy to navigate. I would recommend this to anyone 10/10 👍🏾👌🏾👏🏾
author: DivaExcel

title: Almost
body:
The app is great, has a nice UI developed for iPhones mostly, not really for iPads but still works.
The app should have like an alarm or ringtone to notify the user when he is using or not using the device instead of a notification.
It’s a great app, but the ringtone makes it 5 stars
